mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trade ( id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, price DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0, description TEXT, images TEXT, author VARCHAR(64), date TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'AVAILABLE', buyer VARCHAR(64), payment_time TIMESTAMP NULL )
ALTER TABLE trade ADD COLUMN images TEXT
UPDATE trade SET images = img WHERE (images IS NULL OR images='') AND img IS NOT NULL AND img <> ''
UPDATE trade SET images = REPLACE(images, 'uploads/trade', '/uploads/trade') WHERE images LIKE 'uploads/trade%'
ALTER TABLE trade ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'AVAILABLE', ADD COLUMN buyer VARCHAR(64), ADD COLUMN payment_time TIMESTAMP NULL
UPDATE trade SET status = 'AVAILABLE' WHERE status IS NULL OR status = ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade(title, price, description, images, author, date, status) VALUES(#{title}, #{price}, #{description}, #{images}, #{author}, NOW(), 'AVAILABLE')
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, price, description, images, author, date, status, buyer, payment_time FROM trade WHERE status != 'PAID' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT id, title, price, description, images, author, date, status, buyer, payment_time FROM trade WHERE status != 'PAID' AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT id, title, price, description, images, author, date, status, buyer, payment_time FROM trade WHERE author = #{author} ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT id, title, price, description, images, author, date, status, buyer, payment_time FROM trade WHERE buyer = #{buyer} AND status = 'PAID' ORDER BY payment_time DESC LIMIT 200
